name: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Boots

angles.text: Forging a pair of sturdy green iron boots satisfies the customer and fulfills the order on the parchment.

faq.answer: The writ calls for one pair of green iron boots to satisfy the customer's request.
The parchment directs you to deliver the completed footwear to the destination marked on your map.
faq.q: Where must the boots be delivered?

faq.answer: A line at the bottom of the parchment notes that the document is transferable to another hand.
faq.q: Can someone else fulfill this writ?

faq.answer: You must hold the writ itself in hand to conclude the transaction and receive payment.
faq.q: Why keep the writ on hand?

sections.body: A customer needs sturdy footwear and has committed the request to parchment in faded ink. You must take the finished boots to the appointed destination to settle the account. Keep the trade slip in hand, as payment depends on presenting the document upon arrival.
sections.title: An Order on Parchment

summary: A transferable craftsman's writ calls for a pair of green iron boots. Delivery details and payment await whoever brings the footwear to the appointed place.
